title: Make history check honor [history] exempt entries added later
summary: Today each commit is judged under its parent's config, so an exempt entry added later never covers the commit it names. I read the request as: in `athena check --history`, take the exemption list from the tip's config, as the `[secrets]` and `[personal_data]` allow-lists already are. The validity checks stay: full ids only, and only commits already in history.

defaults_applied.how: Add tests for the new behavior; cargo test and clippy must pass.
One focused change in the gate crate's history and invariant modules.
The intended mechanism was recovered from the review file and the code, not asked.
Behavior criteria are checked with cargo test.
Comments and docs explain why the tip's config is used.

assumptions: Only the full-history check (`athena check --history`, CI) uses the tip's exempt list. Per-commit checks (pre-commit and similar) keep using the parent's config, since there is no tip there.

The mechanism is a new exempt-list field on `HistoryState` in `crates/athena-gate/src/invariant.rs`. `check_history` fills it from `tip_config`, and `invariant::check` consults it when history state is present and falls back to `judged.config.history.exempt` otherwise.
When the tip's config does not parse, the built-in config's list applies, as `check_history` already does for the other tip-level settings.
The existing validation (full commit ids in `config.rs`; new entries must name a commit already in history in `content.rs`) is unchanged. This is what stops an exemption covering a later commit.
Probe 4 in `docs/design/reviews/athena-v0-acceptance-3.md` (an entry added after the fact has no effect) becomes an effective exemption. The review file is a historical record, so it is not edited.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new `athena-gate` test builds a history with a hand-change commit (no Athena trailers). A later commit adds that commit's full id to `[history] exempt` through a declared intervention. `check_history` at the tip then reports no invariant violation for the hand-change commit. Run `cargo test -p athena-gate`.

The existing tests still pass: `a_short_history_exemption_does_not_hide_a_hand_change`, `an_exemption_can_only_name_a_commit_already_in_history`, `exempt_commits_are_skipped`, and the config test that rejects short exempt ids. Run `cargo test --workspace`.
A test shows an exemption still does not cover a commit made after the entry, or a commit not in history. Run `cargo test -p athena-gate`.
The comment above the exemption check in `invariant.rs` and the doc comment on `HistoryState` state that the history check reads the exempt list from the tip's config, and say why.
No governance files are changed. `athena.toml` is not edited, and no records are touched.

out_of_scope: Changing exempt-entry validation (full ids, must be an ancestor)
Changing per-commit (pre-commit) judging by the parent's config
Editing the acceptance review documents or records/
Editing athena.toml or other governance files
departures: Slightly higher cost than the reference. The change touches the gate's history-check logic and needs new tests built on a multi-commit repository fixture.
